set.body:
Outcome

Make the physical repository reflect the single public identity.

Acceptance

- One mvpa crossProject is aggregated and tested on JVM and Scala.js.
- mvpa-fit, mvpa-dataset, and mvpa-spatial project definitions, aliases, README entries, and module-map edges are removed.
- Dependency direction remains acyclic and justified.
- Examples import one public mvpa vocabulary.
set.title: P6.5: consolidate build graph, packages, aliases, and module documentation
